max-contracts-and-artifacts:
    name: max-contracts-and-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      - name: Install schema validator
        run: python -m pip install jsonschema
      - name: Run unit contracts and adversarial artifact tests
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -v
      - name: Validate Max source and registry anchors
        run: |
          python scripts/check_crossframe_max_v6_full_source.py --repo .
          python scripts/check_crossframe_max_v6_registry_anchors.py --repo .

promax-contracts-and-artifacts:
    name: promax-contracts-and-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      - name: Install ProMax test dependencies
        run: python -m pip install jsonschema pytest PyYAML
      - name: Validate ProMax v8 source and knowledge
        run: |
          python scripts/check_crossframe_promax_v8_full_source.py --repo .
          python scripts/check_crossframe_promax_v8_knowledge.py --repo .
      - name: Parse every ProMax JSON schema
        run: |
          for schema in skills/crossframe-promax/schemas/*.json; do
            python -m json.tool "$schema" > /dev/null
          done
      - name: Run ProMax runtime, materializer, routing, and installer contracts
        run: |
          python -B -m pytest -q \
            tests/test_promax_*.py \
            tests/test_promax_materializer.py \
            tests/test_promax_repository_integration.py
